integrity.mathematical_evidence: Exact stationary generator plus positive-coefficient and Descartes argument; executable symbolic checks included.
integrity.publication_priority: A broader unindexed finite-state solution may contain this particular optimization; not independently audited.

scientific_limitations: Three sites only; symmetric nearest-neighbour hopping, one interior departure-time defect; equal endpoint and contact scales.
Only stationary mean signed current is proved; no finite-time counting fluctuations, arbitrary geometry or larger channels.
Infinite-departure-speed case interpreted as a one-sided parameter limit.
title: A unique finite-speed throughput optimum in a three-site trap-exclusion channel
